lead: A property default has to be a constant, so an array literal with anything in it is refused where it looks like it should work.
body: `public array<string> $notes = ["one", "two"];` is `E0435` — a default is evaluated once at compile time and written into every fresh instance's slot, and only a scalar literal, `[]`, an enum case or another class's `const` may be written there. Give the class a no-argument `constructor` and fill the property in it, which also keeps the class enumerable by `Core\Program::implementing`.
